bio.text: Matt Gress is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 4, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.
According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Gress grew up in small-town Oklahoma, was raised by a single mother, and was the first in the family to earn a college degree.

The profile says Gress taught high school English, served on the Madison Elementary School District Governing Board from 2017 to 2021, and was the state's chief budget director before joining the Arizona House.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 4 (candidate-submitted statements)
